objects.name: Analytic 1781
objects.description: For Android, detect Data Encrypted for Impact by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate Application Permission via Android Enterprise DPC / Application Vetting [DevicePolicyManager.getPermissionGrantState(); PackageManager manifest/requested-permission review]; Application State via Android Enterprise / EMM [Managed package inventory/status and package metadata]; OS API Execution via Application Vetting / Instrumented Dynamic Analysis [Dynamic API/runtime trace: ContentResolver, DocumentProvider, StorageAccessFramework, or bulk stream I/O invocations exceed $FileModificationRateThreshold$ operations per minute across distinct file paths — API-level operation rate distinguishes ransomware from norma]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: Approved file management and backup apps. Derive from MDM catalog. Tightening: empty — all MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE holders flagged outside MDM agent.
Default 50 file writes/minute across 3+ directories. Derive from legitimate backup/sync app baseline. Tightening: 20 writes/min — catches slower encryption.
Default 3 distinct parent directories within window. Single-directory encryption is less confident.
Default 60s observation window for rate calculation.
